reason: M0.3A v3 requires R-gated transitions to bind the current exact frozen M0.2 receipt and input bundle. Frozen Stage 1 exposes only a deterministic decision_id and explicitly states that decision IDs are not authenticated receipts; it publishes no receipt schema, immutable receipt record, or exact input-bundle interface. The current M0.3A caller-supplied receipt_digest is therefore an invented semantics and cannot satisfy the v3 contract without changing frozen M0.2 or receiving an authoritative adapter contract.
affected_components: M0.3A receipt/repository binding and replay evidence
remediation_required: Director and the frozen-M0.2 authority must provide an immutable, exact, versioned M0.2 receipt/input-bundle contract or explicitly revise the accepted M0.3A contract through the documented review process.
The resolution must specify source records, canonical bytes/digests, currentness and how an M0.3A runtime verifies them without changing Stage 1 decision semantics.
Data must replace caller-supplied receipt_digest fixtures with that authoritative adapter and rerun the complete M0.3A acceptance matrix before completion.
